props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent environment sprite atlas for the Soul of Meal top-down 2.5D web RPG. Create ONE square 2048x2048 image containing EXACTLY 16 individual object sprites in a regular 4-column by 4-row grid, each invisible cell 512x512. Every sprite is entirely contained in its own cell with transparent padding, no overlap or cell borders. View: elevated front, looking from south, orthographic game overworld, consistent soft sunlight from upper left. Style: beautiful crisp hand-painted miniature Vietnamese fantasy village, detailed terracotta tiles and wooden beams, jade greens, warm cream plaster, charming clean readable silhouette at small game size. Original artwork only. Row 1 left-to-right: lush round broadleaf tree with visible trunk; a tall golden green conifer tree; a pink flowering tree with two tiny warm lanterns; a lush coastal palm tree. Row 2: a cozy village healing kitchen house, steam emblem without letters; a village shop house with green awning and jars; a quiet home with warm terracotta roof and potted flowers; a wooden food market stall with baskets. The three houses face south and show their doorway on the front wall at 37.5 percent across the full visible building width from its left, with the base level near bottom of the cell. All buildings show no side walls extending beyond their silhouette. Row 3: a rustic wooden signpost with blank board; a wooden storage chest with brass fittings; a small stone fountain with still teal water; a small arched village gateway. Row 4: a pottery herb planter; a wood park bench; a tall warm paper lantern on a wood post; a small cozy wood kitchen counter with bowl and kettle. Small soft ground contact shadows within each silhouette. Background must be fully transparent alpha, NOT a checkerboard or colored fill. No people, characters, text, labels, numbers, logos, icons, UI, grid lines, watermarks. Do not create a complete scene; this is a production sprite atlas with isolated objects.
terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original terrain texture atlas for a warm Vietnamese fantasy top-down web RPG, Soul of Meal. Create a square 1536x1536 image consisting of EXACTLY 16 edge-to-edge square texture tiles arranged in a strict 4 by 4 grid with no borders, no dividers, no gaps, no labels. Every cell is an independent flat TOP-DOWN terrain material, light subtly from upper left, finely hand-painted 2.5D miniature game art, charming refined detail, readable gentle variation, no large objects or horizon, no perspective distortion. Every tile must be fully filled and horizontally/vertically repeatable without a visible edge. Row 1 left-to-right: soft jade meadow grass with tiny blades; a darker herb garden grass with subtle small leaves; pale warm sandy earth walking path with tiny pebbles; weathered muted terracotta brick paving in flat staggered courses. Row 2: calm muted teal canal water with a few delicate small ripples and no bright foam; light honey-brown worn wood floorboards; cool grey slate wall stone masonry viewed flat; pale warm cream indoor stone tiles. Row 3: deep emerald green grass; pale misty coastal sand with tiny shell specks; muted dusty mauve evening meadow grass with a few tiny fallen petals; faded cream and sage square mosaic floor. Row 4: lush taller meadow grass seen directly from above, with few subtle overlapping tufts; earth-colored garden soil with sparse small herbs; warm grey cobblestone walking path; dark brown wooden floorboards. Consistent colors and scale throughout. No people, houses, trees, standing objects, UI, words, logos, grid outlines, watermarks. Opaque background. Original assets, no copied game graphics.
